title: Iran ramps up threats against US, removes cap on ballistic missile range
summary_full: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the removal of missile range restrictions while preparing for asymmetric warfare. This statement follows limited US strikes targeting Iranian anti-aircraft systems in the region. Reports indicated that explosions in Qeshm Island were due to Iranian air defense exercises and not hostile actions. US officials claim the Iranian air defense systems were severely weakened during previous conflicts.
